what: After 5 seconds hands-off the page slowly scrolls down by itself at 30px per second — showing a photo mosaic list flowing like an exhibition. Wheel, touch, press or keys stop it immediately and the 5 seconds are counted again. It stops at the very end or when the tab is hidden. Only on wide screens (769px and up)

options.min: Minimum window width to turn on (px), default 769 — 0 means on phones too
options.fx:auto: Event fired by the element attached when auto-scrolling starts
options.per: If frame, speed is read as px per frame (default is px per second)
options.grow: When per: frame, if window width ÷ grow is larger than speed, that value is used — the original Brand uses max(2, width/1440)
options.resume: Seconds before flowing again after interaction, same as the default idle — only the first start waits for idle
options.follow: If wheel, it flows in the direction of the last wheel input (up if scrolled up), stopping at the very top and very end
options.stop: If wheel, only the wheel counts as a stop (press·touch·keys ignored)

note: When ScrollSmoother is present, move with scrollTo(y, false), which places the page right at that spot with no smooth follow. The position is read from the window scroll value, and a position moved by another route (scrollbar, keys, script) is accepted as is and continued from there
